title: Two Women Relaxing Outdoors, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black and white snapshot capturing two women sitting on a patch of lawn outside a stucco home. The woman on the left wears glasses and a short-sleeved blouse, while the woman on the right wears a patterned summer dress with her hand raised near her nose. A handbag sits on the grass beside them.
